description: PostgreSQL community events in a date window: conferences, PGDays, meetups, online events, Call for Papers and registration deadlines, conference talks (with speakers and their pg.ddx.io person hash), Talking Postgres episodes, release dates and commitfests. Same data as the iCalendar feeds at https://pg.ddx.io/calendars (community event listings from the PostgreSQL Event Calendar, curated by Andreas Scherbaum).

kind.description: event, cfp, deadline, session (a conference talk), release, or signal

person.description: pg.ddx.io person hash (8 hex): only their talks/appearances

series.description: Series slug, e.g. pgconf-eu, pgconf-dev, posette, talking-postgres

where.description: Country (ISO code or name, e.g. 'de', 'Germany'), region slug (europe, north-america, south-america, asia-pacific, middle-east-africa), a series slug (pgconf-eu, talking-postgres, ...), or 'online'

name: upcoming_events
